messages:
Carla M: Heads up — promote to prod is blocked, staging canaries failing. deploybot shows an artifact checksum mismatch for pkg-wheels 1.9.2
deploybot: promote blocked: manifest digest mismatch for artifact gs://redwood-builds/pkg-wheels-1.9.2.whl (expected sha256: 3f8a..., found sha256: 7c2d...)
Ben K: Ugh. Is this the same wheel that passed CI earlier today?
Alice P: Looks like the storage upload might have been partial. I saw a retry in the build logs around 15:12 that had an exit 0 but truncated size.
Carla M: Staging integration tests fail intermittently when installing that wheel — test logs show import errors from missing compiled C extensions.
Evan (oncall): tagging: @alice @ben can you confirm we should hold the release window? Current change window ends in ~90m.
Alice P: Yes hold. Don't promote. We should either pin to the last-good wheel (1.9.1) or rebuild/publish a corrected 1.9.2 and re-run canaries. Leaning to pin so we keep the window.
Ben K: Agree. Pin to 1.9.1 for now. I'll create a quick rollback release PR to pin the Dockerfile and requirements.txt and mark as urgent.
Carla M: If we pin, we also need to add a note in release notes and notify product. I'll draft a one-liner.
Ben K: Working on PR now — will reference this thread. Command to verify current artifact digest:

```
# from deploy machine
gsutil cat gs://redwood-builds/pkg-wheels-1.9.2.whl | sha256sum
# expected: 3f8a...\n```

Ben K: The actual digest from the stored file matches deploybot: 7c2d..., so upstream publish definitely corrupted.
Evan (oncall): What's the rollback plan? Manual promote after PR merge? Any risk to DB migrations?
Alice P: No DB changes in this deploy. Manual promote to staging/prod after the pin merge should be safe. We'll avoid automated promote until a human double-checks artifacts.
Carla M: Can we add a temp gate in deploybot to reject promotes when manifest digest != registry digest? Might avoid silent corrupt publishes.
sre-bot: Logged incident INC-2026-054: artifact integrity failure during release. Assigned to release-team.
Ben K: PR opened: github.com/redwood/release/compare/pin-wheel-1.9.1 (wip). Adding patch to CI to fail publish if upload size checksum mismatch.
Alice P: I'll rebuild wheel 1.9.2 in a parallel CI job and hold off promoting it until we validate checksum and run a smoke canary. If it passes, we can publish a new 1.9.2+rev and then schedule a follow-up promote outside this change window.
Carla M: OK plan: 1) merge pin PR to unblock release window (manual approval from release lead), 2) disable auto-promote for this job, 3) publish fixed wheel and run canaries, 4) follow-up promote with release note and incident summary.
Evan (oncall): I'll coordinate the approval and push the manual promote once PR is merged and we confirm artifacts. tagging @release-leads for sign-off.
Alice P: Also adding a short postmortem checklist in the PR templates about verifying artifact digests for binary artifacts.
Ben K: quick note to ops: if anyone sees workers trying to re-download 1.9.2, they should be pointed at 1.9.1 or blocked. I'll add a temporary redirect/alias in the package index to prevent accidental installs.
Carla M: thanks team. I'll send the release hold message to #release-war-room and Product. :thumbsup:
